faultBoundaryMethod.commitBeforeLostAck: Same production consumer committed through Spring transaction proxy; deliberately invalid real delivery tag closed broker channel at ACK boundary; real broker redelivery reserved once.
faultBoundaryMethod.retryAndDeadLetter: Actual PG constraint failures, rollback of order/held/ledger, confirmed persistent retries through quorum TTL/DLX, finite dead-letter, real missing retry exchange retaining unacknowledged original.
faultBoundaryMethod.brokerNack: Real capacity-limited quorum queue returned basic.nack; separated from synthetic channel-close negative confirm.
faultBoundaryMethod.integrationTestConsumerMode: Direct invocation of production listener with real AMQP channels; scheduled publisher/listener disabled to isolate fixtures. Separate production JAR proof below runs scheduled publisher and real listener container.
